__comment: Hoffnung. A black double-edged sword outside Vollstaendig; the override swaps in the bow at bleach_mod:released 1, which is Vollstaendig. The predicate is state/2, so the Schrift reads 0.5 and does not reach it. See client/HeiligBogenModels and item/HoffnungItem.
__comment_parent: item/handheld, not item/generated — generated has no hand display block, so the sword rendered in the flat-item pose with the blade across the wielder's head. The other eleven blades inherit bleach_mod:item/asauchi for their grip, but that carries the Asauchi's texture and geometry too, which would put a Shinigami katana in a Quincy's hand. handheld is vanilla's own sword grip and costs nothing but the parent line.
